clauses.requirement: Where the lamp includes a daytime running lamp function (not stated for this product), its light distribution shall conform to the standard light distribution of UN R148 Figure A3-II.
Where the lamp includes a category 6 direction indicator lamp for the outer side of the vehicle (not listed for this product), its light distribution shall conform to UN R148 Figure A3-IV.

The reversing lamp shall meet the standard light distribution of UN R148 Annex 3 para 2.5, i.e. the minimum intensities of emitted light at the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle relative to the axis of reference.

The reversing lamp light distribution shall conform to UN R148 Figure A3-V: values in the figure are in cd; directions H = 0° and V = 0° correspond to the axis of reference, which on the vehicle is horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, oriented in the required direction of visibility and passing through the centre of reference; the values shown give the minimum intensities in cd for the various measurement directions.
Where the lamp includes a rear fog lamp function (not listed for this product), it shall meet the standard light distribution for rear fog lamps of UN R148 Annex 3 para 2.6.

Where the lamp includes a rear fog lamp function (not listed for this product), its light distribution shall conform to UN R148 Figure A3-VI; if visual examination reveals substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall ensure that, outside the axes, no intensity measured within the rhombus defined by the extreme directions of measurement is below 7.5·10^1 cd.

Where a rear registration plate lamp is used (not listed for this product), for vehicles of category L it shall be considered for plate category 2 of size 280 x 200 mm per UN R148 Annex 3 para 3.7; this is not applicable to the M1 vehicle category.
Where a rear registration plate lamp is used (not listed for this product), measuring points for plate size 280 x 200 mm shall be as given in UN R148 Figure A3-XV.
